annotations.title: Score a business idea (MOAT: fund, fix, or flee)

description: Score a business idea on Margin, Operations, Advantage, and TAM (1-10 each). 30+ = FUND IT, 20-29 = FIX IT, under 20 = FLEE IT. Returns the weakest factor, how to fix it, and red flags from pain / money / willingness-to-suffer checks. Educational rule of thumb, not financial advice.

money.description: Buyers have money to spend? Default true.

operations.description: How easily it runs without the founder, 1-10.

pain.description: Fixes a measurable pain? Default true.

suffer.description: Founder willing to push through a long build? Default true.

tam.description: Market size and proof that people buy, 1-10.
